requirement: Remove remaining embedded-game ads and keep eager loading without starting timers before a game becomes active.

architecture.decision: Never execute the next game in a hidden iframe. Warm its origin and document with preconnect, dns-prefetch, and prefetch links; mount the iframe only when active. Extend the existing tab-scoped blocker only with ad systems verified in current game pages.
seams: No inactive third-party iframe may exist, so hidden timers, analytics, audio, or popups cannot start.
The next game still receives best-effort network warming without executing its JavaScript.
Ad blocking remains limited to Puzzle Date-enabled tabs and must not block first-party gameplay services.

tasks.title: Audit remaining game ad systems
tasks.intent: Inspect the public HTML/scripts of every current game and identify only confirmed remaining ad roots and narrow cosmetic markers.
tasks.acceptance: A source-backed list maps each affected game to confirmed domains/selectors, with uncertain or gameplay-critical endpoints excluded.
tasks.verify: Supervisor rechecks representative public HTML/script evidence.
tasks.result: Confirmed missing roots: raptivecdn.com, media.net, vntsm.com, ezojs.com, lngtd.com, fuseplatform.net; exact first-party ad paths: ||fourbythree-stats.hankmt.workers.dev/ads and ||www.nytimes.com/ads/; narrow selectors mapped for Word500, Waffle, Unwordle, Poople, and 4x3. FoxiMax, Verticle, and Full Circle had no confirmed additions; Chain It was excluded after a security checkpoint. Supervisor independently reverified Unwordle Ezoic, Poople Fuse, Word Salad Longitude, and Waffle page evidence.

tasks.title: Replace hidden iframe preload with timer-safe warming
tasks.intent: Mount only the active iframe and warm the next game using document/origin resource hints.
tasks.acceptance: No inactive iframe is rendered; the next URL gets preconnect/dns-prefetch/prefetch hints; Unwordle cannot start its timer before activation; active navigation and new-tab games remain unchanged.
tasks.verify: npm run build:pages && npm run validate:extension && git diff --check plus DOM verification.
tasks.result: Removed the hidden next-game iframe and its preloaded CSS. Only the active iframe renders; the next game receives deduplicated preconnect, dns-prefetch, and document-prefetch links that are cleaned up on rotation changes. Build, extension validation, and diff checks pass. Focused lint reports only two pre-existing set-state-in-effect diagnostics.

tasks.title: Block confirmed remaining ads and package release
tasks.intent: Add the audited ad endpoints/selectors, bump the extension version, update release copy, and regenerate the ZIP.
tasks.acceptance: Confirmed remaining ads are blocked without broad gameplay selectors; version and package agree; all automated checks pass.
tasks.verify: npm run validate:extension && npm run package:extension && npm run build:pages && unzip -t public/downloads/puzzle-date-game-reset.zip && node --check chrome-extension/background.js && git diff --check.
tasks.result: Version 1.0.14 adds the six audited ad roots, two path-only first-party filters, and narrow game-specific selectors. Three collision-safe session rules per Puzzle Date tab cover domain and exact-path blocking and are all removed on tab close. Release copy and ZIP are updated; validation, packaging, Pages build, ZIP/source equality, JS syntax, and diff checks pass.
